description: Pre-signing verdict for one EVM contract call: builds the calldata, re-encodes it with the full ABI and exact signature, builds an unsigned tx (placeholder nonce and gas; the wallet sets the real ones), approves the calldata against the ABI (blocktools evmApproveCall: ok, unknown_selector or bad_calldata) and checks the unsigned tx with blocktools verifyTx. Returns verdict pass or fail with reasons, the data, target and value, and verifyTx's CHECK THESE text. Show the verdict before the user signs; do not send on fail. SwapChan never signs, sends or broadcasts. Powered by blocktools (ABI coding). How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

abi.description: Optional ABI JSON to use instead of the Sourcify / Etherscan lookup (labelled as pasted; not checked against source).

args.description: Arguments in order; arrays/tuples as JSON lists, big numbers as decimal strings.

chainId.description: EVM chain id or name (1 eth, 8453 base, 42161 arbitrum, 10 optimism, 137 polygon, 56 bnb, 43114 avalanche, 59144 linea, 534352 scroll).

function.description: Function name, or the full signature for overloads, e.g. "balanceOf" or "get(uint256)"

name: contract_approve_call
title: Pre-signing check of a contract call (unsigned, nothing sent)
